name: On Guard in Stonetalon
summary: In Ashenvale, Sentinel Thenysil sends travelers south to check on Kaela Shadowspear. The scout went into Stonetalon to watch Venture Company incursions with a gnome mage, but word from her has fallen silent.

sections.title: A Scout Sent South
sections.body: In Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil watches for threats pressing toward the ancient forest. Her friend Kaela Shadowspear went into the Stonetalon Mountains at Sentinel Wolfrunner’s order, to survey turmoil in the heights. Thenysil asks passing Alliance champions to find Kaela; no word has come, and she fears for her friend’s safety.

sections.title: Uneasy Partnerships in the Crags
sections.body: Kaela’s companion is a gnome mage assigned by Alliance leaders. The night elves joined the Grand Alliance for strategic reasons, but many Sentinels distrust arcane practitioners and gnome tinkers in the wilderness. Kaela keeps an outpost on the bluffs above Windshear Crag, where she watches the Venture Company’s widespread devastation.

aliases: who starts on guard in stonetalon
faq.answer: Sentinel Thenysil, a night elf sentinel in Astranaar, Ashenvale, offers it.

faq.q: Where can I find Kaela Shadowspear?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear is encamped on a rocky ridge overlooking the valley entrance to Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why is Sentinel Thenysil worried about Kaela?
faq.answer: Kaela went to investigate dangerous hostile incursions in Stonetalon and has sent no word back. Thenysil is also wary of the gnome mage assigned to accompany her, a pairing she sees as an omen of trouble.

faq.q: What threats are active in the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: The unscrupulous Venture Company, a goblin mining and logging cartel, is tearing up the wilderness. Aggressive native beasts and rival Horde forces are also pressing in from the south.
Tara is Sentinel Thenysil’s first name. When you meet Kaela, she fondly calls her old friend Tara and takes pride in her work coordinating scouts and adventurers.

faq.q: What happens after finding Kaela Shadowspear?
faq.answer: Reaching Kaela completes the journey and leads to further work helping her and her gnome partner watch the threats encroaching on Windshear Crag.

angles.text: This marks Alliance frontier security moving south, from Ashenvale’s defense outposts to isolated scouting perches in the Stonetalon Mountains.
As a night elf, you see the strain between traditional Sentinels and the arcane and mechanical ways of their Eastern Kingdom allies, especially gnomes.
As a gnome, you may find Sentinels’ deep skepticism toward gnomish magic and contraptions a hard welcome. They see a gnome mage in Kalimdor’s wilderness as an odd, unpredictable presence.
